title: Vegan Dutch Crunch Peanut Roast
description: A delicious vegan take on traditional Dutch crunch, featuring roasted peanuts for added texture and flavor. Perfect as a snack or light meal.
instructions: In a bowl, mash the chickpeas using a fork or a potato masher.
Add the vegan mayo, nutritional yeast (if using), salt, and black pepper to the bowl. Mix well.
Transfer the mixture to a baking dish and drizzle with olive oil.
Roast in the preheated oven for 20-25 minutes, or until the top is lightly browned.
Remove from the oven and let cool slightly.
Serve warm or at room temperature.
Garnish with additional peanuts and nutritional yeast if desired.
